title: High-efficiency photocatalysis in Ca–Cr doped BiFeO3 nanoparticles via bandgap tuning
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38510-38521
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06225J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anika Rahman Riya, Abrar Daiyan, Mehedi Hasan Prince, Troyee Mitra Aishi, Tinni Dey Prome, Md. Abdullah Zubair, Md. Fakhrul Islam, Takian Fakhrul
In this work, Ca–Cr co-doped BiFeO3 nanoparticles with tuned bandgap exhibit enhanced ferromagnetism and 93% visible-light methylene blue degradation at neutral pH, showing strong potential for sustainable wastewater treatment.
